#rm(list = ls())
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(vegan)

load(here("Data", "permanova_matrix.Rdata")) #unscaled matrix
load(here( "Data", "annotation_col.Rdata")) #metadata

numeric_metrics <- keep_metrics[keep_metrics %in% colnames(heatmap_matrix)]
permanova_matrix <- as.matrix(heatmap_matrix[, numeric_metrics])

# check that everything is numeric
storage.mode(permanova_matrix) <- "numeric"

#scale
scaled_permanova_matrix <- scale(permanova_matrix)

#Z-score scale
scaled_permanova_matrix <- scale(permanova_matrix)

# K=11 was best model in lmer (see script called ED50_and_K_cluster_lmer)
group_permanova <- adonis2(scaled_permanova_matrix ~ K_11, 
                           data = annotation_col, 
                           method = "euclidean", 
                           permutations = 999)

print(group_permanova)
